newsitem.title: USA: Emery launches B727 service to Norfolk.
newsitem.headline: Emery launches B727 service to Norfolk.

text.p: Integrated air freight carrier Emery Worldwide said it has inaugurated direct freighter service to the Norfolk area.
Emery said in a statement that the new nightly Boeing 727 service, which it describes as the only regular freighter service, feeds the carrier's Dayton, Ohio, sorting centre.
The company added that flights depart Norfolk at 2040 local time, returning the next morning at 0630.
The new service will carry both next-day express traffic and industrial heavy freight, Emery said.
It described Norfolk as a predominantly inbound market. The region's large industrial base includes the automotive and ship repair industries.
Emery is a division of the Consolidated Freightways Inc group.
